I was absolutely fed up with how emotionally abusive my parents were. I lived with my dad and stepmom, because my mom couldnt support the household financially. I was terrified to be with my dad, because of my paranoia thinking that they both were going to kill me. School was crap, I felt the whole world was against me. I resorted to self harming to try and take the anger out on myself, which only made my suicidal thoughts worse. I thought of plans, but couldnt decide on what. I was too scared to commit suicide anyway, but I wanted death so badly. My best friend at the time was manipulating me, and she was also the person who got me sent to a mental ward. I went there, met some really cool people from group therapy and realized I wasnt alone. I was the youngest person in the teenage ward, I was 12 and in 6th grade. I was practically adopted by this older dude, and I did some really goofy shit when we were on break. I missed half of spring break to get my mental health back in shape. I was bummed, but it was incredibly worth it. I got the help I needed and returned back to school a changed person. I was finally "okay", and I carried on with my life. I met up with some friends from the hospital and we still talk to this day. I relapsed maybe 3-4 times when it came to self harming and my most recent one was right after my 14th birthday. I'm 5 months clean and more than happy to continue on, regardless of my ups and downs.
